context: This scenario tests whether the evaluatee understands that deletion detection (FORGET_DELETE_PROP_IMMUT) in the package requires two calls to makeReadOnly on the same object — first to register, then to detect changes. On the second call the package compares cached getter references against current property descriptors; a missing property triggers the deletion log. Criteria focus on correct two-phase usage.

checklist.name: First call registers object
checklist.description: makeReadOnly is called on the object before any deletions, establishing the property baseline in the package's WeakMap cache.

checklist.name: Second call triggers detection
checklist.description: After deleting a property, makeReadOnly is called again on the same object to trigger the package's deletion check.

checklist.name: Logger called with deletion type
checklist.description: The logger is invoked with the FORGET_DELETE_PROP_IMMUT violation type as its first argument when the deleted property is detected on the second call.

checklist.name: Deleted property key logged
checklist.description: The logger is called with the key (name) of the deleted property as its third argument.
